title: Cube Battler: Story of Shou
native_title: キューブ・バトラー ～デバッガー翔編～
overview:
Now, games surpass OVA!! Digital Battle Animation

Cube Battler: Story of Shou is a head-to-head puzzle battle told through anime scenes, starring the young debugger Shou. Each fighter has a playfield where picture cubes must be turned and placed to rebuild the image playing in the background.

Take cubes from the tray at the bottom of the screen, rotate them to the right face and drop them into your 3 x 4 grid, while launching attacks on your rival or defending against theirs. Finish your picture first, or drain your opponent's strength to zero, to win the battle.

- Anime story scenes between battles
- One player story or two-player versus
- Memory backup saves

今、ゲームはOVAを超える!!
デジタルバトルアニメーション
